text.p: Windswept Environmental Group Inc said Friday that it has settled all outstanding shareholder lawsuits, and is no longer a party to any litigation in which it is a defendant.
The company said the lawsuits concerned disaffected investors who purchased Windswept shares in 1995 following representations of certain members of senior management.
Windswept said it settled in order to minimize its financial liability, but did not disclose the financial terms of the settlements.

The company added that it does not believe the settlements will adversely affect its financial condition or its results from operations for this fiscal year and in the future for certain required prospective payments.
Windswept Environmental Group offers a broad range of services in the areas of hazardous waste remediation, asbestos removal, lead clean-up, laboratory testing and emergency spill response.
